news.title: Last grizzly bear of the Prairie?
news.description: A 1929 letter by Wilfrid Daniel Richer recounts a journey through the Saskatchewan woods and discusses accounts of grizzly bears on the Canadian Prairies. Contributed by Barry Richer.

history.title: Notre-Dame des Neiges de Masson
history.source: Souvenir paroissial de Notre-Dame des Neiges de Masson
history.description: A parish history page with portraits of clergy and photographs of early parish buildings. Wilfrid Daniel Richer is listed as parish priest for 1896–1897.
